# 微信公众号\n\n把文章写进草稿箱、发布、拿到永久链接。**国内唯一一条「A: # WeChat Official Accounts Write articles to the draft box, publish them, and obtain permanent links. **The only primary domestic channel combining an established API, support for financial content, and sufficient reach.** ## Three prerequisites 1. **The account must be a verified service or subscription account.** Since July 2025, WeChat has removed publishing API access from accounts owned by individuals and unverified business accounts. Those accounts receive 48001. 2. **The calling server's public outbound IP must be allowlisted**, or every endpoint returns 40164. Configure it under **Settings & Development → Basic Configuration → IP Allowlist**. This is easy to overlook in containers: run `curl ifconfig.me` inside the container to check its actual outbound IP rather than guessing. 3. **Published articles do not enter the historical message feed.** `freepublish` produces permanent links suited to keeping an article available and directing readers from elsewhere. **It is not a mass broadcast.** Broadcasting uses separate endpoints and limits, including a restricted number of monthly sends. ## Setup In the account console, obtain **AppID** and **AppSecret** under **Settings & Development → Basic Configuration** and enter them in the credential. The secret is shown only when generated; if lost, it must be reset, immediately invalidating the old one. Add the server's outbound IP to the allowlist as well. Click **Test** to obtain a token and read the draft count. This **checks three things at once**: whether the secret is correct, whether the IP is allowlisted, and whether the account has publishing permission. > ⚠️ **Use a single replica.** The access_token is globally unique. Obtaining another for the same AppID immediately invalidates the previous one. > Multiple replicas invalidate each other's tokens, causing intermittent 40001 errors. > The plugin retries once automatically, but that is not a solution for multiple replicas. ## Example workflow ``` [Cover image] → [Upload image: cover] ────────┐ ├→ [Create draft] → [Human review: optional] → [Publish draft] → [Article link] [Body images] → [Upload image: article body] ─┘ ``` **Why draft creation and publishing are separate:** the draft can be inspected in the account console before publication, a useful review point for financial content. Whether to add a human-review node is your choice; connect the two steps directly for a fully automated flow. ## Three pitfalls the plugin checks before publication **A cover image is required**, and it must be the media_id of a permanent asset. Use **Upload image** with the purpose set to **Cover**. Without it, WeChat returns the unclear error 41005. **Externally hosted images in the article body will not display**, due to WeChat's hotlink protection. First use **Upload image** with **Article body image** to obtain an `mp.weixin.qq.com` URL, then put that URL in the HTML `` attribute. Before creating a draft, the plugin scans the body and rejects external images, preventing publication of an article whose images are missing. **Publishing is asynchronous.** A successful `submit` means only that the task was accepted; it may still fail during an originality declaration or platform review. By default, **Publish draft waits until publication finishes** before returning, with readable status names such as success, publishing, original_failed, audit_failed, and banned. ## Supported article HTML Basic HTML is supported: p, h1-h6, strong, em, ul, ol, blockquote, img, a, and table. Scripts, iframes, and external stylesheets are **not supported**; some inline styles work. For complex layouts, prepare the design elsewhere and convert it to this restricted HTML. ## Limits | Item | Limit | |---|---| | Title | 64 characters | | Summary | 120 characters; if blank, WeChat takes the first 54 characters of the body | | Cover image | 10 MB | | Article body image | **1 MB**, a different limit from cover images | | API calls | Daily quotas vary by account; exceeding them returns 45009 | ## Common error codes | Code | Meaning | |---|---| | 40164 | IP is not allowlisted—the most common error | | 48001 | The account lacks access to the endpoint, commonly because it is unverified or individually owned | | 40001 | AppSecret is incorrect, or another replica invalidated the token | | 45009 | API call rate limit reached | | 53405 | Noncompliant content; financial articles should pay particular attention to stock recommendations and promises of returns |
